title: Performance Optimization and Lazy Loading
description: Learn techniques to improve React app performance, including memoization, code splitting, and lazy loading for faster load times and smooth user experience.

lessons.title: Why Performance Matters
lessons.content: Fast, responsive apps improve user experience and retention. React performance optimization helps minimize rendering time and resource usage.

lessons.title: React Rendering Basics
lessons.content: Understanding how React renders components and how updates trigger re-renders is key to optimizing performance.

lessons.title: Using React.memo for Component Memoization
useMemo and useCallback Hooks
Avoiding Unnecessary Re-renders
lessons.content: Tips include using keys correctly, splitting components, and avoiding anonymous functions in props.

lessons.title: Code Splitting with React.lazy and Suspense
Dynamic Imports and Chunking
lessons.content: Dynamic imports split code into smaller chunks loaded on demand, reducing initial bundle size.

lessons.title: Optimizing Images and Assets
lessons.content: Use compressed images, lazy load images, and optimize asset delivery for faster page loads.

lessons.title: Using Performance Profiling Tools
lessons.content: React DevTools Profiler and browser tools help identify performance bottlenecks.

lessons.title: Best Practices for Performance
lessons.content:
- Keep component state minimal
- Use PureComponent or memo
- Avoid inline functions and objects
- Use virtualization for long lists
